§2.1.2: partition_observed reuses the existing path_ecosystem predicate (same one the declared side applies) to skip a reference whose source file belongs to another ecosystem — before the module bucket and admit_observed — counting it in the new cross_ecosystem total and cross_ecosystem_by_source breakdown (None = no-manifest-ecosystem source); the none-detected view (ecosystem_prefix None) admits everything (P-DEP-02). §2.1.3/§2.1.5: unattributed_reason renders the cross-ecosystem sentence (breakdown + --ecosystem see-flag for the largest NAMED group + manifest-scope remainder clause) and is byte-identical when cross_ecosystem==0; compute_unattributed takes &ProvenanceRead and the none-detected reader_context re-sources unattributed.reason; the JSON envelope gains additive `cross_ecosystem`. §2.1.4: deps_reader_context_note filters its language list by language_deps_ecosystem(tok).is_none() (names only reader-less languages) and appends parsed_manifest_inventory_clause built from ProvenanceRead::Tracked records with error==None, grouped by ecosystem TOKEN (java, never gradle), counts ascending, see-flag = most-parsed (ties alphabetical); empty when not Tracked / no parsed record (byte-identical pre-slice). Three DEP-C03 tests added.
§2.1 call site only: the compute_unattributed invocation passes &input.manifest_provenance (already read upstream); no other change.

§2.1.5: DepsListResponse gains additive `#[serde(default)] pub cross_ecosystem: u64` so an older daemon's envelope (no key) deserializes to 0 and renders as today (the ⚠ line is the daemon's reason verbatim; no render-logic change). (2) gstreamer — reader sentence BEFORE `⚠ no dependency-manifest reader for C/C++/Java/JavaScript/Python/Rust on this build; 14216 external includes observed, not attributed to packages` (false: Rust/Java/JavaScript/Python DO have readers and their manifests parsed); AFTER `⚠ no dependency-manifest reader for C/C++ on this build; 14216 external includes observed, not attributed to packages; 13 manifests of other ecosystems were parsed (4 cargo, 8 java, 1 npm) — see deps list --ecosystem java`.
